meta.description: First run with no credential: set your wallet address (a label), mint a free key, post a sample demand on its sandbox key, and read what to do next. The key is shown once in Register Free Key's output: save it as a Taifoon Relayer API credential, then use 10-buy-through-taifoon.json. Successful executions are not saved, so the key does not stay in execution data.
